metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Koozies | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film koozies for vibrant, full-color branding. Perfect for events and giveaways. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing on koozies gives you vibrant, full-color artwork with fine detail and soft hand feel. Unlike screen printing, DTF handles gradients and photographic images easily, making it ideal for complex logos or promotional designs. These custom direct to film koozies are durable through washing and work on polyester fabric sleeves, so your brand stays bright through tailgate parties, trade shows, and summer events.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film koozies with full-color printed logo on fabric sleeve
